snippet.title: Stress-free cozy game Organized Inside launches ✨Nov 20th! ✨
snippet.description:
BIG NEWS! 🎉 

Cozy organizing game Organized Inside launches November 20th!

No pressure, just pure satisfaction for all perfectionists. ✨

Wishlist now!
👉 s.team/a/3609750

Key Features：
- 1000+ Familiar Items: Free placement!
- A Truly Relaxing Experience: No timers & No health bars & No scores 
- Relatable Scenarios: 5 Everyday Stories of People Around You!
- Meow-ster Tutors on Duty: Paw-some Guidance Guaranteed！
- Demo on Steam (Support Windows & MacOS) ！

#indiegame #cozygames #indiedev #screenshotsaturday #steam #cozygaming #獨立遊戲
